presentation.label: PAD SELECT
presentation.summary: With PAD+TRIG SEL TRK checked, the pads and TRIG keys 1-12 sound only in LIVE and STEP RECORDING; otherwise a press selects its track silently and FUNC + pad plays it.
presentation.overview: Pad Select adds PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, a checkbox after AUTO TRK SWITCH. Checked, a pad or TRIG key 1-12 makes sound only in LIVE or STEP RECORDING. Stopped, playing or in GRID RECORDING, a press selects its track and stays silent, with no MIDI note out; hold FUNC and press the pad to play it, at the pad's own velocity. CHROMATIC mode, MUTE mode, MIDI notes in, TRIG + YES and the sequencer behave as stock. Unchecked, everything is stock. The setting is kept per GLOBAL slot and saved with the project.
highlights: Tap pads to pick tracks without hearing them.
FUNC + pad plays, at the pad's own velocity.
LIVE RECORDING and STEP RECORDING work as stock.
One checkbox per GLOBAL slot, kept through a power cycle; unchecked is stock.
usage: Use a build containing Pad Select. Open the GLOBAL menu, then CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, and check PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, just after AUTO TRK SWITCH, with YES or LEFT/RIGHT.
With the sequencer stopped, tap the SD pad: it makes no sound and the SD track is selected. Hold FUNC and tap SD to hear it at the pad's own velocity. TRIG 5 selects track 5 silently.
Press RECORD + PLAY for LIVE RECORDING: pads play and record as stock. Uncheck PAD+TRIG SEL TRK to get stock behaviour everywhere.

access.location: GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
steps: Open the GLOBAL menu and choose CONTROL, then SEQUENCER CONFIG.
Move to PAD+TRIG SEL TRK, after AUTO TRK SWITCH, and press YES (or RIGHT) to check it.

controls.name: PAD+TRIG SEL TRK
controls.doc: Checkbox in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: outside LIVE and STEP RECORDING, pads and TRIG keys 1-12 select their track silently. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: FUNC + pad
controls.doc: While PAD+TRIG SEL TRK applies, plays the pad's track at the strike's velocity (stock FUNC + pad plays at the TRIG page's VEL), with its aftertouch, and selects the track only if AUTO TRK SWITCH is checked, as stock. FUNC + TRIG 1-12 stays as stock and plays nothing.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
Tested in rytm-emu only; not yet run on a unit.
FUNC + TRIG 1-12 plays nothing, as on stock: outside live recording, use FUNC + pad to hear a track.
TRIG 13 (the FX track), the SOUND BROWSER's pad audition and pads with a menu open are silent too; FUNC + pad plays.
PLAY during LIVE RECORDING ends live recording, as on stock; the pads are silent again from then.
RTRG + pad outside live recording selects silently; FUNC + RTRG also toggles the metronome click, as on stock, so it is not a clean way to roll.
A GLOBAL slot saved without the setting, or received as Global SysEx, loads unchecked.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG row after AUTO TRK SWITCH

load.display: None in the audio path: a few compares per pad or TRIG key press
load.conditions: Static: the sites are in KeyboardView's pad and TRIG key handlers, their shared play routine, the pad-pressure handler and the SEQUENCER CONFIG menu's constructor; each press reads one storage bit and the record state. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

tests.summary: Emulator (rytm-emu c5732f0, OS 1.74, build PS03), against stock from matched snapshots: checked, pads and TRIG keys select silently wherever stock would play them (no voice, no MIDI, no aftertouch, analog output unchanged), FUNC + pad plays at the strike's velocity and follows AUTO TRK SWITCH, LIVE and STEP REC and every other key mode are as stock; unchecked matches stock exactly; kept through a power cycle (0.2.0), per GLOBAL slot. Not run on a unit.
